summary.ja: 核配置ごとに電子基底状態を収束させ、得られた力で核の古典運動を進める。
summary.en: Converge the electronic ground state at each nuclear configuration and propagate classical nuclei with its forces.

references.label: M. Born and R. Oppenheimer (1927), Zur Quantentheorie der Molekeln
references.scope: Publisher bibliography and DOI checked. Cited for the historical basis of Born–Oppenheimer separation, without claiming a full-text audit or reproduction of a modern MD implementation.

references.label: R. Car and M. Parrinello (1985), Unified Approach for Molecular Dynamics and Density-Functional Theory
references.scope: Publisher bibliography/abstract and original equations (3)–(5) and discussion of fictitious electronic motion near the BO surface consulted. The paper’s silicon dynamics have not been numerically reproduced.

assumptions: Classical nuclei and a selected adiabatic electronic ground-state model; no verified MD implementation.
Displayed extended-Lagrangian formulas assume fixed cell and fixed occupations.
assumptions_ja: 核は古典力学、電子は選択した断熱的基底状態モデル。MDの実装・検証は未実施。
表示する拡張ラグランジアンは固定セル・固定占有を仮定。
units: Atomic units for energies/forces/time with nuclear masses stated explicitly; CP orbital mass is a numerical convention.
units_ja: エネルギー・力・時間は原子単位系とし、核質量を明示。CPの軌道仮想質量は数値的な規約。
boundary_conditions: Choose isolated or periodic boundaries for the target system; no executed MD case is published.
boundary_conditions_ja: 対象に応じて孤立・周期境界を選びます。実行済みのMD例は未公開。

next_deliverable.ja: 多原子の力を独立参照と照合し、時間刻み・SCF公差または仮想質量への感度とNVEドリフトを測る。
next_deliverable.en: Compare multiatom forces with an independent reference, then measure timestep/SCF or fictitious-mass sensitivity and NVE drift.

limitations.ja: 解説のみ。今回の固定Heセルのエネルギー比較は、原子間力・MD軌道・温度制御の検証を含みません。
limitations.en: Reading only. Fixed-He energy comparisons do not validate interatomic forces, MD trajectories or thermostats.

caution.ja: 解説のみ。今回の固定Heセルのエネルギー比較は、原子間力・MD軌道・温度制御の検証を含みません。
caution.en: Reading only. Fixed-He energy comparisons do not validate interatomic forces, MD trajectories or thermostats.
